title: Taylor Swift Pops Out at Tight End University to Support Travis Kelce for the Second Year in a Row
summary: The pop star posed with the football player and his TEU cofounders in a photo at the event.
contentText:
Class is in session at Tight End University, and Taylor Swift is in attendance. At Travis Kelce ‘s annual event that brings together the NFL’s tight ends and raises money for charity, the pop superstar showed up for the second year in a row to support her fiancé.

Related

Taylor Swift Surprises Tight End University Crowd With ‘Shake It Off’ Performance

Travis Kelce’s Tight End University Is Returning With Tight Ends & Friends Show in 2026: Here’s the Date

Travis Kelce Reveals Taylor Swift Pulled Off Her Surprise Tight End University Performance ‘Without Practicing’

In an Instagram photo posted Tuesday (June 23) by TEU, Swift and the Kansas City Chiefs player pose with their arms around each other. The 14-time Grammy winner wears a shiny floral dress and red lipstick, her hair in an updo, while Kelce beams in a simple red-and-white polo.

Also in the photo are Kelce’s TEU cofounders, George Kittle and Greg Olsen, as well as the San Francisco 49ers player’s wife, Claire Kittle, and the former Chicago Bear star’s daughter, Talbot Olsen.

“TEU Yearbook cover worthy,” the caption reads.

The opening-night event comes one day ahead of TEU’s first-ever public practice at Vanderbilt Stadium on Tuesday in Nashville, which will be followed that night by a Tight Ends & Friends concert at The Pinnacle. The show will feature “surprise musical guests” — possibly meaning Swift, who gave a surprise performance of “Shake It Off” at TEU 2025.

“[She] just went out there without practicing, and it was pitch-perfect,” Kelce later raved of his now fiancée’s 2025 performance on New Heights .

That said, the Eras headliner may have her hands full with other things. Beyond promoting her Toy Story 5 song “I Knew It, I Knew You,” which recently became her 15th career Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 hit, there have been many reports that Swift and Kelce plan to get married over Fourth of July weekend, possibly at Madison Square Garden in New York City.

“We know [the World Cup final] coincides with July 4th, America 250, Taylor Swift’s wedding, all happening at the same time,” Zohran Mamdani recently said at a press conference, although his team later told Billboard that the NYC mayor was simply referencing outside reports on the matter and didn’t have confirmation of his own about the nuptials.
